title: Atomic Policy: Composing Atomic Manipulation Skills with Agentic Reasoning
title_zh: 原子策略：用智能体推理组合原子操作技能
abstract: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to translate task intent into physical interactions as the scene changes. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer semantic and spatial reasoning, while visuomotor policies provide fine-grained control. Yet ambiguous goals and dependencies between actions make their integration challenging. We introduce Atomic Policy, a framework that composes learned manipulation skills through grounded steering and execution feedback. A VLM estimates the symbolic state and goal, and a PDDL solver constructs a skill plan. An agentic harness steers each skill through language, visual pointing, or both, and verifies its outcome to guide phase transitions and replanning. A common phase-level interface supports specialized policies and generalist action models. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot show how Atomic Policy improves task following and supports recovery in complex, long-horizon manipulation. Project page: https://aaronzkd.github.io/atomic-policy/
abstract_zh: 长时程操作要求机器人在场景变化时将任务意图转化为物理交互。视觉语言模型（VLM）提供语义和空间推理，而视觉运动策略提供细粒度控制。然而，模糊的目标和动作间的依赖关系使它们的集成充满挑战。我们提出原子策略（Atomic Policy），一个通过接地引导和执行反馈来组合学习到的操作技能的框架。VLM 估计符号状态和目标，PDDL 求解器构建技能计划。一个智能体执行框架通过语言、视觉指向或两者兼有的方式引导每个技能，并验证其结果以指导阶段转换和重新规划。一个通用的阶段级接口支持专用策略和通用动作模型。在仿真和真实机器人上的实验表明，原子策略如何改进任务遵循，并在复杂的长时程操作中支持恢复。项目页面：https://aaronzkd.github.io/atomic-policy/
tldr_zh: 原子策略框架用VLM和PDDL组合技能，提升长时程操作。
cover_zh: VLM+PDDL组合技能｜长时程操作也能自我纠错
